change_summary: Compute the experiment-only entry-day ranking surface and sweep a cap-aware post-sizing top-up for non-ETF/non-Commodity core signals with 0.30 < alpha_score < 0.70 and 0.30 < alpha_score_components.breadth_alignment < 0.70.

mid_weak.state_note: rotation-heavy bull where strategy makes money but lags indexes

old_thin.state_note: mixed-to-weak older tape with lower win rate

field_check.note: This risk-allocation experiment does not depend on these fields.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: capital allocation: mid alpha_score plus mid breadth_alignment may mark supported but not over-extended core entries.
gate_questions.2_history_check: Raw top-alpha, relative-strength, breadth-low, trend-high, and low-theme component top-ups already failed nearby Gate 4 checks. exp-20260524-012 provided the new point-in-time component attribution; no prior log entry tested this alpha/breadth interaction.
gate_questions.3_single_causal_variable: post-sizing multiplier for 0.30 < alpha_score < 0.70 and 0.30 < breadth_alignment_component < 0.70
gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: docs/backtesting.md three fixed windows; require positive aggregate EV/PnL, no unacceptable drawdown/survival/trade-count/sample/concentration deterioration, and no production/backtest split before promotion.

hypothesis: Entry-day attribution shows the strongest surviving core profits are not only in raw high-alpha or raw high-breadth buckets. A mid alpha_score plus mid breadth_alignment interaction may identify non-overheated, sufficiently supported core entries that deserve a small cap-aware top-up without changing entries, exits, universe, news, or LLM logic.
known_risks: High multiple-testing risk because several adjacent ranking-component scouts failed.
The interaction is production-computable but not yet promoted as a strategy input.
If accepted, production parity requires shared implementation before orders change.
Small multipliers can still change only a subset of candidate trades due cap and integer-share guards.

next_retry_requires: Do not retry adjacent alpha/breadth thresholds or multipliers on the same frozen windows without new forward rows or a materially different interaction.
A valid retry needs replacement-value evidence, concentration governance, or a broader point-in-time interaction family.
notes: No JavaScript used. This is alpha_search, not measurement repair. scripts/claim_experiment.py could not claim this id because it was not pre-registered.

production_impact.promotion_required_if_accepted: Move alpha_score, breadth_alignment component exposure, and the sizing policy into shared daily context/risk/portfolio modules with parity tests, then rerun the same three-window protocol before production use.

rejection_reason: Best variant failed adjusted-signal sample guard; the mid alpha/mid breadth interaction did not touch enough sized core signals.
why_not_other_changes: Skipped LLM soft-ranking because replay-safe attribution remains sparse. Skipped SEC/event/state-surface/broad-market/candidate-pool scalars because those lanes have recent rejected or strict-gated nearby trials. Skipped raw component retries because exp-20260524-012 showed raw components are saturated, sparse, or already failed as direct top-ups.
